shared_elements: low relief carving of figures on a flat vertical slab
human or humanoid figure with visible arms and hands
horizontal register or banding dividing the surface
justification: Both are low-relief vertical slabs showing profile creatures and a humanoid figure with a disc-like circular motif, but that is about as generic as shared relief iconography gets. A shows a stacked assemblage of schematic zoomorphs (quadrupeds, birds, snake-like forms) with a small crouching figure and a row of repeated animal heads, whereas B shows a single dominant, anatomically detailed bearded human figure in profile with elaborately patterned garment and coiffure filling the whole field \u2014 wholly different subject, proportion and rendering conventions.
